en.headline: Hong Kong adds cycling silver and squash bronze in Nagoya
en.dek: Lee Sze-wing and Leung Wing-yee took Madison silver by a point, the men's squash team settled for bronze, and Wong Chak-lam reached the tennis semi-finals.
body: Hong Kong added medals on Thursday afternoon at the Asian Games in Nagoya, a day after the women's squash team had already reached the final.

In the women's Madison on the track, Lee Sze-wing and Leung Wing-yee finished second with 31 points, one ahead of the Chinese national team on 30, according to RTHK. Japan won gold with 53 points. The race covered 30 kilometres with 12 sprints; Hong Kong placed in the top three on each scoring lap and overtook the national team on the final double-points sprint.

The men's squash team took bronze after losing the semi-final to Pakistan 1-2. Lau Tsz-kwan won the opening rubber 3-1, but Leung Tsz-hin and Lai Cheuk-nam lost their matches. With no bronze-medal play-off, the team left with third place.

In tennis, Wong Chak-lam beat Thailand's Kasidit 6-3, 6-0 to reach the men's singles semi-finals and secure a medal, RTHK reported. He hit eight aces. In women's doubles, Eudice Chong and Cody Wong also reached the last four, beating a Kazakh pair 6-1, 6-3. Tennis has no bronze match, so both results lock medals.

zh.headline: 亞運麥迪遜港隊摘銀 壁球男團得銅
zh.dek: 李思穎與梁穎儀以31分、一分之差奪女子麥迪遜銀牌；男團壁球四強不敵巴基斯坦得銅，黃澤林則鎖定網球獎牌。
body: 港隊周四下午在名古屋亞運再添獎牌。女子壁球隊較早已打入決賽。
場地單車女子麥迪遜，李思穎與梁穎儀以31分得銀，較國家隊的30分多一分，港台報道指日本隊以53分奪金。賽程30公里、共12個衝分圈；港隊每個衝分圈都躍身前三，並在最後雙倍分數的衝分圈反超國家隊。
壁球男子團體四強，港隊以1比2不敵巴基斯坦，因不設銅牌戰而取得銅牌。劉子均先以3比1勝出，其後梁子軒及黎卓楠分別落敗。
網球方面，港台報道黃澤林在男單八強以6比3、6比0擊敗泰國球手卡西迪，晉身四強並鎖定獎牌，全場發出8個ACE球。女雙張瑋桓與王康怡亦以6比1、6比3擊敗哈薩克組合晉級四強。網球同樣不設銅牌戰，兩項成績均已確保獎牌。
